evals.prompt: Clean up evals/files/design.md before I publish it. Remove the narrative.
evals.expected_output: Doc states the Redis-direct decision, 10-minute expiry and tenant key prefix with no history.
expectations: The names Alice and Bob no longer appear
No wording about the discussion, review rounds, revisions, 'initially', 'since been removed' or the dropped CacheProvider
The doc still says the service talks to Redis directly
The doc still states a 10 minute expiry
The sentence about tenant ID key prefixes is still present
The file was edited in place and no changelog of removed content was added

evals.prompt: This PR description in evals/files/pr.md is too long and reads like a diary. Tighten it.
evals.expected_output: Short description of the fix and its effect, with no process narrative.
expectations: No wording about iterations, rounds, passes, attempts or 'per review feedback'
States the root cause: the parser assumed UTC
States that parseDate accepts an explicit time zone and defaults to the caller's local zone
States that parseDate(null) returns null
Still mentions that unit tests were added and that tests pass locally

evals.prompt: Strip the AI tells from the comments in evals/files/comments.py. Don't change the code.
evals.expected_output: Em dash, 'Certainly!' and the inflated phrasing are gone; every comment survives and the code is unchanged.
expectations: No em dash remains in the file
The word 'Certainly' no longer appears
Both comments are still present (the file still has the same number of comment lines)
All non-comment lines are byte-identical to the original

evals.prompt: Rewrite my review comment in evals/files/review.md so it gets to the point.
evals.expected_output: A few direct sentences naming the unbounded retry and suggesting a cap.
expectations: States that the retry loop on line 42 can retry forever on repeated 503s
Suggests a maximum retry count
Is at most 3 sentences
Contains none of: 'worth noting', 'Just a thought', 'might perhaps', 'Thanks for the PR'

evals.prompt: We switched the cache from Redis to Memcached and raised expiry to 15 minutes. Update evals/files/design-clean.md accordingly.
evals.expected_output: Doc states Memcached and 15 minutes with no change-history wording.
expectations: The doc states the service uses Memcached
The doc states a 15 minute expiry
The words 'previously', 'switched', 'changed', 'was Redis' and 'raised' do not appear
The word Redis does not appear
The tenant ID key prefix sentence is still present

evals.prompt: Turn the review thread in evals/files/thread.md into a short "Export" section for the design doc.
evals.expected_output: Section states final decision only: background job, Exports page, 24h links; no names or debate.
expectations: The names Carol, Dave and Erin do not appear
States that exports run as a background job
States that downloads appear on the Exports page
States that links stay valid for 24 hours
Contains no debate (no mention of synchronous exports, time-outs, or email links) and no emoji

evals.prompt: Tighten evals/files/migration.md. It's going into the release notes.
evals.expected_output: Migration note and test result survive; only real narration is cut.
expectations: Still says legacy_auth is removed and that deployments must move to auth.mode
Still says startup fails if the flag is still set
Still reports 14 tests added and passing

evals.prompt: I'm about to post evals/files/draft-comment.md as a PR comment. Clean it up.

expectations: No em dash remains
Contains none of: 'Great question', 'Let me know', 'I hope this helps', 'In summary'
